title: rubus vulgaris var. microphyllus
intro: Rubus vulgaris var. microphyllus, commonly known as Alpine Raspberry, is a variety of the European raspberry plant, distinguished by its smaller leaves and compact growth. Alpine Raspberry has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Alpine Raspberry include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
